versions.content: When PduR_<DstLo /DstLoTp >TxConfirmation is called and the FIFO queue is not empty in case of direct data provision <DstLo /DstLoTp >_Transmit shall be called with the oldest I - PDU of the FIFO. The transmitted I - PDU shall be removed afterwards.

When PduR_<DstLo/DstLoTp>TxConfirmation is called and the FIFO queue is not empty in case of direct data provision <DstLo/Dst LoTp>_Transmit shall be called with the oldest I-PDU of the FIFO. The transmitted I-PDU shall be removed afterwards.

If direct data provision is used with a FIFO: when PduR_<DstLo>TxConfirmation is called and the FIFO queue is not empty <Dst Lo>_Transmit shall be called with the oldest I-PDU of the FIFO. The transmitted I-PDU shall be removed afterwards.
